params.prompt: A 2010 small-business website in typical Web 2.0 style: glossy grey-to-white gradient header with company name «Компания» and menu «Главная · Каталог · Услуги · Контакты», a big glossy orange rounded banner with reflection and text «Лучшие решения для вашего бизнеса», a red starburst badge «NEW!», a stock photo of smiling people in an office, rounded glossy buttons «Узнать больше», Verdana text, light grey page background with drop shadows, a right sidebar with rounded boxes and RSS icons, a footer with tiny links. Typical template look of that era, slightly cheesy. Flat, straight-on full-page screenshot of the web page only: no browser window, no monitor, no device, no hands, no perspective, fills the whole frame edge to edge. Crisp and legible. No real brand logos, no watermark.
